card.name: Qualifier words in clinical findings
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug or study term in results text, such as an adjective, noun or verb like adverse, adult, substitutions, suggest or trials. Seen mostly in dense safety and study-results sentences.

modes.label: Noun or adjective after drug-treated
modes.description: A patient or reaction word follows a hyphenated drug term.

modes.label: Verb or hedge in findings
modes.description: Words like suggest or moderately that soften a study finding.
modes.example: influenza antigens were<< moderately>> lower in patients receiving adalimumab

modes.label: Partway through a medical word
modes.description: The start of a longer word such as morbidity or equivocal.
modes.example: associated with<< morb>>idity and mortality and an increased risk of
